description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing and analyzing fenced code blocks or spans within markdown or text buffers, being useful for markdown parsers or editors that handle fenced code sections.

methods.name: export function parseFenceSpans(buffer: string): FenceSpan[] { parseFenceSpans
methods.description: Parses a string buffer to identify fenced spans (such as code blocks) based on fence delimiters (` ``` ` or ` ~ ~ `). Returns an array of FenceSpan objects representing each fenced section.

methods.name: export function findFenceSpanAt(spans: FenceSpan[], index: number): FenceSpan | undefined { findFenceSpanAt
methods.description: Finds the fence span that contains the provided index within a list of FenceSpan objects, using binary search for efficiency.

methods.name: export function isSafeFenceBreak(spans: FenceSpan[], index: number): boolean { isSafeFenceBreak
methods.description: Determines if a given index in the buffer is outside any fence span, indicating whether breaking at this position is safe (not breaking within a fenced code block).
